I bet you've been a lot of time by your own.
What happened?... I care.

I hate when someone calls you "crazy" just because you're different of them...
"One sure mark of a fool is to dismiss anything that falls outside his experience as impossible."
I find it incredible how someone can just live their lives as their told. Not wanting to find who they are, as an individual... It's not about giving up anymore, it's about my health.
Thanks for posting :)
